record.notes: These are inference credits, not general compute. The vendor contradicts itself on expiry: the pricing FAQ says the credit is 'available until you use it up' and contrasts it with free tiers that 'expire after 12 months', while the managing-projects documentation says promotional credits expire one year from signup. A third-party deal page reports both readings and advises planning for 12 months (grabaicredits.com, 2026, reported). Treat the 12-month reading as the safe one; the console balance is the only authority for a given account. The 'over 700 hours' figure is the vendor's, and 775 hours is a division at the pre-recorded Nova-3 rate. Re-read on 2026-10-23: the pricing page states no expiration and the terms end the balance at account closure, so the 12-month caution above remains the safe reading.

record.category: speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice-agent API, one-time signup credit

free_tier.stated: Free USD 200 credit on the Pay as you go plan with no minimums, no expiration and no credit card required; the vendor puts it at roughly 43,000 minutes, over 700 hours, of Nova-3 transcription. One-time, not a monthly allowance. Rates drawn from it: Nova-3 monolingual pre-recorded USD 0.0043 per minute, Aura-2 text-to-speech USD 0.030 per 1k characters, Voice Agent Standard USD 0.075 per minute.
free_tier.notes: models on the pricing page: speech-to-text Flux STT and Nova-3 (plus Whisper Large pre-recorded), text-to-speech Flux TTS, Aura-2 and Aura-1, and a Voice Agent API that bundles speech-to-text, a managed language model and text-to-speech at one per-minute rate

record.interface_detail: REST and WebSocket at api.deepgram.com (North America), with regional hosts api.eu.deepgram.com, api.au.deepgram.com and api.in.deepgram.com
record.tooling: raw HTTP and WebSocket calls with an API key created in the console
record.chaining: the credit pays for batch transcription of recorded audio, which a free CI runner can post file by file, and for text-to-speech; pair it with a free object store for the audio. Streaming and voice-agent loads hit the per-project concurrency caps before the credit is spent.

free_tier.stated: 'Apply to Deepgram for Startups and get up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months', with applicants required to be 'An AI builder or early-stage startup', 'In production or looking to launch in the next 6 months', and 'Committed to actively building and engaging with our community'. The programme terms add that participation is 'subject to our approval and ongoing eligibility, which we determine in our sole discretion', that applicants must give 'information about your company's funding, product, and team', and that promotional credits 'Expire 12 months from the issue date' and 'Can only be used after you've used up Deepgram's standard signup credits'.
